ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels to high-intensity (white) pixels; surface area is approximately 98% dark-field with limited high-intensity regions restricted to the tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark-field mapping across both lobes; secondary mapping includes high-contrast white punctate spots scattered on the left lobe and larger irregular white clusters at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 105 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 12% of the vertical lobe height at the center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration along the entire boundary; peak-to-valley pixel amplitude increases significantly toward the distal tips, creating a jagged, non-linear profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a consistent concave sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips; overall lobe orientation follows a divergent upward trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the distal tips of both lobes; right tip shows a dense, roughly circular cluster with a diameter of approximately 1/20th of the lobe width.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple faint, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the medial portion of the left lobe, primarily oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular thickening and extreme serration at the distal lobe tips, consistent with extensive scarring or localized barnacle colonization sites.
